name: Coda
tagline: Doc platform that combines writing, tables, automations, and small apps

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $12/Doc Maker/month monthly, Team at higher tiers.

verdictSummary: A doc with tables and buttons is buildable; Coda's editor, formula engine, packs/integrations, permissions, and team workflows make full parity difficult.
coreLoopDIY: Build a rich doc editor, embedded tables, formulas, buttons, and simple automations.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because docs become tools that teammates can understand and maintain.

priorArt.name: AFFiNE
priorArt.desc: Open-source workspace with docs, whiteboard, and knowledge-base features; partial Coda-lik

notes: Useful sibling to Notion/Airtable; more formula/workflow oriented.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Coda (Doc platform that combines writing, tables, automations, and small apps). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build a rich doc editor, embedded tables, formulas, buttons, and simple automations.
- Needs: rich text editor.
- Needs: database tables.
- Needs: formula engine.
- Needs: auth.
- Needs: integrations.
- Needs: hosted backend.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: formula language; packs; permissions.
